articles.summary: CINCINNATI --(BUSINESS WIRE)--May 12, 2026-- American Financial Group, Inc. (NYSE: AFG) is pleased to announce the promotion of Andrea I. Raible to Assistant Vice President & Controller. Ms. Raible succeeds Robert (Bob) A. Dee, who will retire in June after 41 years of service to the company.
articles.title: American Financial Group, Inc. Announces the Promotion of Andrea I. Raible to Assistant Vice President & Controller
